title: Pigeon Polly Coffee lover
desc: Polly adores coffee. When there's coffee around, her sleepiness level drops — but, of course, anxiety goes up. Oops. Turns out Polly is lactose intolerant, but somehow she still drinks cappuccino.

title: Mr.Chew Office Clerk
desc: Mr. Chew is a loyal yet slightly sluggish office worker. His antennas can pick up Wi-Fi from the archive basement, but phone calls throw him into panic. Always ready for a dramatic exit, and feels guilty for resting—even for five minutes.

title: Miss Peony
desc:
Miss Peony - Bakery Seller
Miss Peony bakes baguettes and buns with love, often giving them away to anyone who looks sad. “A warm bun beats a warm hug,” she likes to say. She’s flustered, floury, and always wears flowers in her feathers.

title: Mr.Crisper
desc: Mr. Crisper is an anxious mouse with a deep emotional attachment to storage boxes. He keeps everything in containers - snacks, secrets, and unresolved issues. Labels them obsessively and panics when lids get mixed. Once cried when someone microwaved a non-microwavable one.

title: Milka
desc:
No one has ever seen all of Milka. She may or may not exist beyond the tail sticking out of a box.
The tail twitches sometimes, but never in response to you.
Can she move? Theoretically, yes.
Do you really want to find out?
Try putting your hand in the box. I dare you.

title: Detective Polly
desc:
Polly knows who ate the last bun.
She’s just not saying… yet.
Works alone. Trusts no one but caffeine and gut instinct. She may look distracted, but she already spotted your lie. Under her wing are hundreds of unsolved cases - and not a single one forgotten.
She never says “I’m sure.” She just stares. And eventually, you talk.

title: Mr.Dr.Fisher III
desc: Mr. Dr. Fisher III has a doctorate in… something. No one really knows what, and he’s not telling. He proudly hangs his diploma on the wall, even if nobody can read it. He’s terribly afraid of his own reflection and can’t drink milk without exploding. Despite having only 7 HP (4 to be honest) and a lot of weird habits, he insists on being called "Doctor" - and gets very upset if you forget.

title: Retro Moka
desc: A vintage coffee maker that floods the air with rich aroma and jolts the mind awake. Its brew reduces Snack Reserves but boosts Caffeine Fuel for those skilled enough to handle it.

title: Slipper (R)
desc: The legendary T-2 Slipper® (Right) is soft, warm, and just a bit smelly — exactly as its previous owner preferred. Slipping it on boosts your Snack Reserves and makes you feel safe, like it’s Sunday morning forever. Sadly, it drains your Cookie Power… maybe from all the crumbs trapped inside. The left slipper? Classified information.

title: Cookie
desc:
The T-3 Cookie is dangerously comforting. One bite, and suddenly everything feels okay — the awkward silence, the social anxiety, the crushing weight of existence. Sure, it makes your life feel slightly more dramatic, but maybe that’s just the sugar rush talking. Crumbly, sweet, and weirdly therapeutic.
(Do not attempt to chew the card.)

title: Vegan Jelly
desc:
This wobbly masterpiece is the crown jewel of experimental vegan cuisine. It restores a whopping 10 HP, but only to those skilled enough to actually prepare it (Cooking Level 4 required). Some say there's a stapler inside, others think it’s just licorice. Either way, it jiggles with confidence and probably won’t kill you.
(Occupies 2 slots. Do not microwave.)

title: Bobby Bagster
desc: Bobby Bagster is not your average raccoon — he’s a true connoisseur of bags. From the crinkle of a paper bag to the satisfying rustle of plastic, Bobby can’t resist exploring every pocket, pouch, or tote he finds. He’s been known to “borrow” grocery bags, hide inside gift bags, and even guard his favorites like priceless treasures. For Bobby, life is simply better when there’s a bag involved.

title: Lady Puddle-Dip
desc: Lady Puddle-Dip is a refined crow with a rather… unusual culinary habit. Every snack she’s given — from cookies to crackers — gets carefully stashed away for a rainy day. Literally. When the clouds roll in, she delights in dipping her treats into fresh puddles, convinced it makes everything taste far better. Some call it eccentric — she calls it gourmet.

title: Sir Pickleknot
desc: Sir Pickleknot is a distinguished pickle with a rather unexpected guilty pleasure — he’s absolutely fascinated by knots. While most pickles are content to float in brine, he spends his free time mastering the delicate art of macramé… and the more intricate world of shibari. His creations are equal parts elegant and questionable, but Sir Pickleknot insists it’s all in the name of “artistic expression.”

title: Dr. Panicoli
desc: Dr. Panicoli is a young broccoli PhD candidate whose academic career is off to… a very anxious start. Nobody knows exactly what has him so terrified — the looming thesis defense, the student loans, or perhaps something far stranger. He jumps at every shadow, keeps triple-checking his notes, and has a permanent wide-eyed look that says, “I’ve seen things.” Whatever it is, it’s enough to keep this broccoli on high alert.

title: Time-slowing Sunflower
desc: This sunny gadget bends time just enough to make your coffee breaks last longer and your cooking feel effortless. With an extra boost of caffeine energy and sharper kitchen skills, you can finally take a well-earned rest — guilt not included.

title: Lucky Penny
desc: A tiny coin with miraculous charm — flip it in your pocket and suddenly cheese, milk, and ice cream are no longer your mortal enemies. Plus, it gives you a small health boost, because feeling lucky is good for you.

title: Slip Trap
desc: A classic prank with a slippery twist — place it just right and watch someone’s grand finale turn into an unexpected slapstick performance. Of course, every fall has its price… minus 2 HP.

title: Split Pearsonality
desc: This tiny green troublemaker has an identity crisis — and it wants to share it with you. Once deployed, it cleanly slices any stat in half, whether for cunning strategy or pure chaos. Use with caution… or don’t.
